FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Hawaii fishing licence

Visitors aged 15 or older need a recreational marine fishing licence. Hawaii also has a separate licence for introduced freshwater game fish.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Non-residents aged 15 or older who fish in the ocean.
  • Anglers who take introduced freshwater game fish, subject to freshwater licence exemptions.

Who doesn’t

  • Marine anglers aged 14 or younger.
  • Active-duty military members in Hawaii, their spouses, and minor children are exempt from the marine licence.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident marine 1-daynon residentSelected calendar day$20 USD
Non-resident marine 7-daynon resident7 days$40 USD
Non-resident marine annualnon resident1 year$70 USD
Tourist freshwater 7-daynon resident7 days$10 USD
Tourist freshwater 30-daynon resident30 days$20 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Wahiawa Public Fishing Area entry permit · $0 USD
    Required for entry to fish, with a freshwater game fishing licence.

Saltwater

Residents need no recreational marine licence. Visitors need the separate marine licence.

Fishing with a guide or charter

DAR advises all non-resident fishing-charter passengers to hold a marine licence, even if they do not plan to fish.

Rules visitors should know

  • A marine one-day licence ends at 11:59 p.m.
  • Deep 7 bottomfish vessels require separate registration.

How to buy

Buy the marine licence online at fishing.hawaii.gov. Online processing fees can apply.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Hawaii?

Visitors aged 15 or older need a recreational marine fishing licence. Hawaii also has a separate licence for introduced freshwater game fish.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Hawaii?

Non-resident marine 1-day: $20 USD; Non-resident marine 7-day: $40 USD; Non-resident marine annual: $70 USD; Tourist freshwater 7-day: $10 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Hawaii?

Buy the marine licence online at fishing.hawaii.gov. Online processing fees can apply.
